description: This file contains the implementation of the TextDumper class in the Twig Profiler component, responsible for formatting profiling data for display in a textual format.

classes.name: TextDumper
classes.description: A final class extending BaseDumper that formats profiling data for output in text form.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Formats profile data related to templates, prefixing with a specific symbol.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Formats profile data related to non-template code, including template name, type, and name.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats profiling time data as milliseconds and percentage.
